title: Seaside "Sisters Three By The Sea" 2056 E County Highway 30A
h1: Seaside "Sisters Three By The Sea" 2056 E County Highway 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHT: - Gulf views- Steps from the beach- Fully equipped gourmet kitchen- Free WiFi- 3 adult bikes- Newly Decorated- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Located in the adorable picturesque community of Seaside between the Odessa Pavilion and Pensacola Pavilion, "Sisters Three by the Sea" is the perfect home for a family getaway and just steps from the closest public beach access. This 3-bedroom, 1,650 sq. foot home offers beautiful light interiors, a gourmet kitchen, and beautiful gulf views from the outdoor porches. Enjoy its proximity to Seaside's Central Square and WaterColor for many shopping and dining options. Just hop on one of the 3 bikes provided and explore the area! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower Only- Twin Daybed with Twin Trundle, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyUnfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.
